diagnostics.message: `resource.null_resource.file_permission` runs a `chmod 600` provisioner against the private key file, but has no dependency on `resource.local_file.private_ssh_key`. The provisioner references only `var.private_ssh_key_filename` (a plain string), so Terraform may run the local-exec provisioner before the key file has been written, causing `chmod` to fail.

`module.runner:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance` boots the runner agent instance whose user-data script manages the value of `module.runner:resource.aws_ssm_parameter.runner_registration_token` (writing the registered runner token into it at boot). The ASG has no dependency on the SSM parameter (the user_data template only embeds the parameter *name* as a string), so the instance can launch and its user-data script can run before the parameter exists.

The ASG has no dependency on the SSM parameter (the user_data template only embeds the parameter *name* as a string), so the instance can launch and its user-data script can run before the parameter exists.

`module.runner:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance` launches the runner agent instance, whose user-data script needs the SSM permissions granted by `module.runner:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm` at boot time (to store the runner token). The attachment and the launch-configuration chain only share the IAM role in common — there is no edge from the attachment to the instance profile, launch configuration, or ASG — so the instance can boot before the SSM policy is attached and propagated.

`resource.local_file.public_ssh_key` has an explicit `depends_on` on `resource.tls_private_key.ssh`, but this dependency is already established by the implicit reference in its `content` attribute (`tls_private_key.ssh.public_key_openssh`). The explicit `depends_on` is redundant and can be removed.

`resource.local_file.private_ssh_key` has an explicit `depends_on` on `resource.tls_private_key.ssh`, but this dependency is already established by the implicit reference in its `content` attribute (`tls_private_key.ssh.private_key_pem`). The explicit `depends_on` is redundant and can be removed.
